description: Use this when someone asks what to do or play at home with a number of friends ("we are 4 friends at home, what can we do?", "what can 2 people play at home?", "6 friends, how do we have a good time?"), with family or kids, games for the TV without a console, party games where phones are controllers, or games to play with friends far away. Given the number of players (and optionally the mood), returns up to 8 matching PadConsole games with player counts and links. Only returns games that fit the group size. Does not start a game.

locale.description: Language the user is writing in: tr (Turkish), de (German), es (Spanish), id (Indonesian) or en (everything else). Default en.

max_results.description: How many games to return. Default 5.

remote.description: True if the players are in different homes; returns only games that support that.

vibe.description: Mood: party (bluffing, laughs), competitive (racing, fighting, football), co-op, trivia, camera (motion/pose). Default any.

name: recommend_games
title: Recommend games for your group
